verdict.rationale: LangSmith documents automations such as rules, webhooks, and online evaluations, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the pack shows those automations can be versioned, reviewed through change history, or rolled back. The 'compare versions' evaluation feature is about benchmarking application versions against datasets, not versioning automations, so it is adjacent and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
